THE PROBLEM STATEMENT
SLIDE 02 / 20

1. UNPREDICTABLE & PRICEY CLOUD BILLS

Firebase and Supabase charge for every single read/write operation and outbound bandwidth. A launch surge causes shocking monthly bills.

2. SETUP FRICTION & COMPLEX EMULATORS

Downloading secret JSON keys, managing bloated cloud consoles, running memory-heavy emulators, and learning proprietary query APIs stalls shipping.

3. LOSS OF DATA OWNERSHIP & VENDOR LOCK-IN

Relational data is trapped inside proprietary cloud storage. Performing raw SQL queries, local migrations, or atomic hot backups is difficult.

4. INFRASTRUCTURE OVERKILL FOR MVPS

Deploying heavy PostgreSQL clusters, Redis queues, and separate auth proxies just for a side-project introduces massive maintenance overhead.

WHAT IS MINIBASE?
SLIDE 03 / 20

MiniBase is an embedded, single-binary Backend-as-a-Service built on Node 22's native SQLite engine running in high-concurrency WAL mode.

Bundles Automated REST APIs, Real-time SSE Streams, File Storage, and a Visual Admin Studio into a single process.

  • Zero External Database: Everything stored in a single data.db file
  • Microsecond Latency: In-process synchronous memory execution
  • Ultra-Low Memory: Runs reliably on ~35MB RAM footprint

KEY ARCHITECTURAL FEATURES
SLIDE 04 / 20

1. EMBEDDED SQLITE WAL

Node 22 native engine with Write-Ahead Logging for simultaneous reads and fast writes.

2. DYNAMIC REST APIS

Schemas immediately generate full CRUD endpoints with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

3. REAL-TIME SSE STREAMS

Server-Sent Events stream live record changes instantly without WebSocket heartbeat overhead.

4. ADMIN STUDIO CONSOLE

Visual web interface to design schema collections, manage permissions, and edit records.

5. LOCAL FILE STORAGE

Integrated multipart file uploads with automated high-speed Sharp thumbnail generation.

6. CLOUDFLARE TUNNEL

Single-flag (--tunnel) command exposes localhost to a public HTTPS URL without router ports.

TERMINAL CLI SUITE
SLIDE 10 / 20
MINIBASE CLI ZOOM
# Start server & open browser
minibase serve --open

# Expose with public HTTPS tunnel
minibase serve --tunnel

# Inspect process health and PID
minibase status

# Execute raw SQL against WAL
minibase sql "SELECT * FROM wallpapers LIMIT 5;"

# Reset admin password via terminal
minibase admin passwd admin@minibase.io newpass

# Create hot database backup
minibase backup ./backups/prod.backup

KEY ADVANTAGES & BENEFITS
SLIDE 16 / 20

ZERO HOSTING COSTS ($0 CLOUD BILLS)

No per-query fees, no read/write meter traps, and no bandwidth surcharges. Host for free on any cheap $3/mo VPS or self-host at zero cost.

MICROSECOND SQLITE SPEED

No network overhead between application layer and database. In-process memory execution delivers microsecond read performance.

100% DATA SOVEREIGNTY & PRIVACY

Your data is stored exclusively in a single local data.db file. Easy to backup, audit, copy, and fully compliant with GDPR privacy standards.

ZERO-CONFIG PORTABLE DEPLOYMENT

No database installation, user permissions, or port bindings required. Clone, install, and run — everything works right out of the box.

LIMITATIONS & WHEN NOT TO USE
SLIDE 17 / 20

SINGLE-NODE ARCHITECTURE

MiniBase uses a local SQLite database file. It is designed for single-server vertical scaling, not multi-region distributed write clusters.

NOT FOR MASSIVE BIG DATA (TERABYTE+)

While SQLite easily handles tens of gigabytes and millions of rows, massive terabyte analytics pipelines are better suited for ClickHouse/Snowflake.

WRITE CONCURRENCY BOTTLENECKS

In WAL mode, SQLite supports infinite simultaneous readers but sequential write commits. Heavy continuous write floods can create lock queues.

NO BUILT-IN PUSH NOTIFICATIONS

MiniBase provides live real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE), but native APNS (iOS) / FCM (Android) background push requires external services.

ROADMAP & FUTURE VISION
SLIDE 18 / 20

LITESTREAM REPLICATION

Automated continuous streaming replication to S3, Cloudflare R2, or MinIO for zero-effort offsite disaster recovery and live read replicas.

CUSTOM PLUGIN & HOOK ECOSYSTEM

Extending the core engine with JavaScript server-side hooks (onRecordCreate, beforeAuth, payment webhooks).

DEDICATED SDK PACKAGES

Publishing official native client libraries on npm (minibase-js), pub.dev (minibase_flutter), and PyPI (minibase-python).

OAUTH2 SOCIAL LOGIN PROVIDERS

One-click social login integrations with Google, GitHub, Apple, and Discord directly manageable from the Admin Studio console.

QUICKSTART & DEPLOYMENT
SLIDE 19 / 20
3-STEP LOCAL SETUP:
# 1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/kothalkarkkartik/MiniBase.git && cd MiniBase

# 2. Install & launch
npm install && node bin/minibase.js serve --open
DOCKER & VPS DEPLOY:
# Docker Compose:
docker compose up -d

# Linux VPS Installer (systemd):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../install.sh | bash

PREDICTABLE INFRASTRUCTURE

Runs as a standalone self-contained background daemon under systemd or Docker container with zero ongoing maintenance.

DESKTOP STANDALONE (.EXE)

Packaged as a Windows executable that launches MiniBase Studio locally without requiring Node.js to be installed globally!
